description: This source file defines the Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker class, which implements IStorageHasherPicker for Orleans v3->v7+ migration scenarios. It manages hash providers and provides logic for selecting appropriate hashers based on grain ID types.

classes.name: Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker
classes.description: Implements IStorageHasherPicker for Orleans v3 compatibility, providing hash provider management and hasher selection logic based on grain ID type.

methods.name: Orleans3CompatibleStorageHashPicker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the hash picker with a non-string hasher.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Selects and returns an appropriate hasher based on the grain ID type, handling special cases for integer and GUID keys.
